question: Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank no.2.
solution:
The correct answer is:** 'teacher'.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The most appropriate option to fill in the blanks is: **'teacher'.**
 
• The particular blank must be filled with **'Noun'.**
 
• Here, the** 'teacher'** is appropriate as this portion speaks about making of lesson.

Hence, the correct answer is: **'Option 4'.**

**Correct sentence**__: The left handed pages (1) __are written__ for the student to use individually, but they may of course be used by the (2) **__teacher__** as a source of ideas and information on which to base a lesson. The student then has the left-hand page as a/an (3)________ of what has been taught and can refer to it in the (4)_______. The exercises can be done (5)_______, in class or as homework.
